checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three scenes in order, ~3s each: Earth, Jupiter, Saturn
must.why: Earth then Jupiter appear, but no true Saturn scene; frame at 8.6s still shows Jupiter with rings. Transitions are blended.

must.item: Date captions exact, with Voyager 1 and Source visible throughout
must.why: Captions garbled ('Tuptetebr: 1977', 'Tutur fiby: 1999', 'Satur fiby: 1980'); source line reads 'Saprety: Sience'. Only 'Voyager 1' is clean.

must.item: Probe has dish and booms, consistent
must.why: Large white dish, booms and decagonal body visible, though the design shifts and is distorted in later frames.

must.item: Jupiter banded and Saturn with prominent rings
must.why: Jupiter is banded, but it has rings drawn on it and there is a second ring-bearing planet. Saturn is never clearly shown.

must.item: No Uranus/Neptune claims, no conflicting dates
must.why: No Uranus/Neptune, but the caption reads 'Tutur fiby: 1999', a conflicting date.
Audio can't be judged from still frames.

faults.what: All captions and the source line are garbled or misspelled; the launch caption is missing 'Launched' and the date.
The Jupiter caption reads 1999, a wrong date.
No Saturn scene. A ringed Jupiter appears at the end, with a second ringed planet beside it.
A stray orbital arc overlay and small duplicate garbled labels sit at the bottom.
The probe's shape warps between scenes. The Earth scene shows a stray empty black octagon.
'Source: NASA Science' is not in the bottom-right corner; it is garbled and centred.

summary: The clip has a good-looking Voyager-style probe and a clean 'Voyager 1' label, but the captions are garbled with a wrong 1999 date, and it never shows a real Saturn, only a ringed Jupiter.
